summary: Generated projects now ship a working release pipeline and take an explicit Docker image and GitHub repository at scaffold time.
highlights: startproject generates a release manifest, GitHub release workflow, and manifest validator.
startproject takes --image and --repo, prompting for both on a terminal.
WEB_IMAGE is written to .secrets/.env as the single source for every compose image reference.
Generated images now carry the release-manifest label, so update dialogs show the version and highlights.
Generated settings report the project version from release-manifest.json.
